# Baking Great Bread at Home — Holiday Gift Guide 2026

> Henry Hunter's 2026 holiday gift guide for bread bakers and sourdough obsessives. Handpicked baking tools, wood bowls, lames, and books, with promo codes built in.

## Pages

- [Holiday Gift Guide 2026](/): The main curated gift guide, Henry's Top 6, category aisles, Krustic and Amazon collections, market-seller gear, and books.
- [Holiday Gift Guide 2026 (long URL)](/bread-baker-holiday-gift-guide-2025): Same guide at its longer canonical route.

## Data

- [Product catalog JSON](/catalog.json): Full structured catalog — main products, Krustic, Amazon, books, free resources, promo codes. Regenerated on every build.
- [Gift guide CSV](/holiday-gift-guide-2025.csv): Flat CSV export of the guide.
- [Pinterest product catalog CSV](/pinterest-product-catalog.csv): Pinterest-formatted feed.

## Optional

- [From Oven to Market](https://fromoventomarket.com/): Course and market kit for bakers ready to sell.
- [Baking Great Bread Blog](https://bakinggreatbread.blog): Recipes and technique articles by Henry Hunter.
